prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot to move the mold from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold is on material station.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A grey metal shelving/rack unit, photographed at an angle, fills most of the frame. It has several horizontal rails, each carrying a row of white and purple printed label cards with black icons and bilingual (Chinese/English) text, e.g. "EcoFlex 0050 B", "Dragon skin 30 A/B", "WACKER Sil 612 B", "Si-Pigment Yellow", "Si-Pigment Brown", "Si-Pigment Green", "Si-Pigment Black". Small white cylindrical pegs and round metal studs are spaced along the rails between labels. On the top shelf sit clear/translucent empty plastic lidded trays or bins. Above, a white sign on a dark bracket reads "Material Storage Area". The background wall is plain white. No liquids or containers with contents are visible.
observations: The photo of the material station shows only labeled rails, pegs, and empty translucent trays on the top shelf; no mold is visible anywhere in the frame, so the mold does not appear to be present for pickup.

args.observations: The photo of the material station shows only labeled rails, pegs, and empty translucent trays on the top shelf; no mold is visible anywhere in the frame, so the mold does not appear to be present for pickup.
